adjudication.rationale: In `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, the decryption path is gated by `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` (added in `packages/lib/constants.ts`), which is truthy only when both `process.env.CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET` and `process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY` are set. Therefore, if `CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY` is unset/empty, the handler returns 403 before reaching `symmetricDecrypt(..., process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY || "")`, so the claimed empty-key fallback behavior is not verifiably reachable from this diff. The note about lacking startup validation is more of an operational/config hardening suggestion than a concrete defect shown by the diff.
